page.overview:
What is Dream Away?

"Dream Away" (Japanese: オ・ラ・イ・ナ・エ, O Ra I Na E) is a song by English rock musician George Harrison from his tenth studio album Gone Troppo (1982). The song was featured over the end credits of Harrison's 1981 HandMade Films production Time Bandits, which was director Terry Gilliam's first successful film outside of his work with Monty Python. Aside from the film's orchestral score, it was the only song featured in Time Bandits and was written specifically for the film. "Dream Away" was also issued as a single in Japan in February 1983.
